categories_checked.note: MSMT: Government Scholarships for developing countries; MEYS bilateral scholarships (incl. Italy). No general state grant or loan for foreign degree students found on MSMT pages (msmt.gov.cz/eu-a-zahranici/studium-cizincu-v-cr).
National means-tested state social assistance benefit (housing component) on mpsv.gov.cz; eligibility for foreign students not stated. CU accommodation bursary recorded under 'university'.
Charles University partner discounts on comprehensive insurance for non-EU students (PVZP 20%, Slavia 10%). No public subsidy found.
PID Prague student season tickets (under 26). National rail/bus student fare discount not checked on an official page (search budget exhausted).
Financial Administration list of tax credits for tax year 2025 has no student credit (sleva na studenta); only basic credit and others.
No subsidy for working students found. Related rules (DPP 300 h, insurance threshold CZK 12,000) are in bureaucracy.json.
Charles University Erasmus+ incoming pages (cuni.cz/UKEN-145.html) list no host top-up for incoming students; incoming grants come from the home institution. Czech outgoing rates not researched.
Prague city (hlavni mesto Praha) student support not searched; web-search budget ran out.
Charles University: accommodation bursary, scholarships overview (Vaclav Havel Bursary, faculty scholarships), PhD income, tuition-free Czech-taught study.

items.name_it: Borse del governo ceco per paesi in via di sviluppo
items.authority: Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports (MSMT) with Ministry of Foreign Affairs
items.description: Government scholarships for citizens of listed developing countries at Czech public universities, for the standard length of full-time study: Czech-taught follow-up master's (with a one-year preparatory course at Charles University's UJOP) or selected English-taught master's and PhD programmes.

eligibility.residence_requirement: Not open to Czech or EU citizens or to foreigners with Czech permanent residence
other: 2027/28 countries: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Ukraine, Belarus (democratic opposition), Ethiopia, Gabon, Mauritania, Zambia, Bangladesh, Cambodia, Palestine, Guatemala, Honduras
Completed bachelor's (for master's) or master's (for PhD)

items.how_to_apply: Online application on studyin.gov.cz (one registration per applicant), with motivation letter and tests.
items.notes: Monthly amount is set in the 'Guidelines 2026' document linked on the page, not opened. No legal entitlement to the scholarship.

items.name_local: Stipendia MSMT na zaklade dvoustrannych dohod (Italie)
items.name_it: Borse del Ministero ceco dell'istruzione da accordi bilaterali (Italia)
items.authority: Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports (MSMT/MEYS)
items.description: Study or research stays of 3-6 months at a Czech public university for students and graduates of Italian universities (also Italian citizens enrolled at Czech public universities), usually non-degree. Tuition is waived and dormitory/canteen access is possible. Similar bilateral schemes exist for other countries listed by MSMT.

other: Enrolled at an Italian university (bachelor, master, PhD), or Italian citizen enrolled at a Czech public university
Nominated via the Czech Embassy in Rome

items.amount: CZK 12,000/month (no master's degree yet) or CZK 13,000/month (master's holders), 2026/27
items.how_to_apply: Online application on studyin.gov.cz with CV, study plan, 2 recommendation letters, transcript; assessed by the Czech Embassy in Rome, then MSMT and host faculty.
items.deadline: 2026/27 call ran 15 Jan - 27 Feb 2026; no open call on 2026-11-25 (MSMT expects the 2027/28 offer in autumn 2026)
items.notes: Travel costs are not reimbursed. Nationality field set to eu_eea because the programme is for Italy; other countries have their own bilateral calls.

items.name_local: Davka statni socialni pomoci (slozka na bydleni)
items.name_it: Prestazione statale di assistenza sociale (componente alloggio)
items.authority: Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs (MPSV) / Labour Office (Urad prace CR)
items.description: Means-tested benefit in force since 1 Oct 2025 combining living, housing, child and work components. The housing component helps when housing costs exceed 0.30 x household income and the household has a legal title to the dwelling (lease, accommodation contract).

eligibility.income_test: Means and property test on household income (living component below 1.43 x living minimum)
eligibility.min_work_hours: Work activity of at least 30 hours/month or other listed activity, unless exempt
other: Eligibility of foreign students is not stated on the MPSV page

items.how_to_apply: In person at any Labour Office branch or online via the Jenda client zone; not retroactive.
items.notes: Benefit facts are from MPSV, but whether foreign students (EU or non-EU, without permanent residence) can receive it was not found; do not present it as available to students.

items.name_local: Komplexni zdravotni pojisteni cizincu - studentska sleva (PVZP, Slavia)
items.name_it: Sconto studenti su assicurazione sanitaria completa per stranieri
items.authority: Charles University with Pojistovna VZP and Slavia pojistovna
items.description: Charles University partner offers for non-EU students' mandatory comprehensive health insurance: PVZP 'Comprehensive Medical Insurance EXCLUSIVE' with 20% student discount (4-60 months) and Slavia 'Comprehensive Health Insurance for Foreigners - 131' with 10% discount (1-60 months).

other: CU degree or exchange students (incl. PhD) under 35, language/preparatory course students (PVZP)
Slavia offer also for CU alumni under 35 on a job-seeking permit

items.how_to_apply: Online with the insurer; PVZP via a sales representative for students over 30 or with pre-existing conditions.
items.stackable: Not exclusive: any insurer compliant with Czech law may be used instead.

items.name_local: Zlevnene jizdne PID pro studenty (do 26 let)
items.name_it: Tariffa ridotta studenti PID Praga (fino a 26 anni)
items.description: Discounted Prague (zones P, 0, B) season tickets for full-time students aged 18 to 26. Only season tickets are discounted, not single tickets. Charles University cards can be used as proof/pass.

other: Full-time student with a study confirmation or valid ISIC (ISIC only for students studying abroad)

items.amount: Student: CZK 130/month, CZK 360/3 months, CZK 1,280/year (full price CZK 550 / 1,480 / 3,650); tariff page 'valid as of 10.12.2023', checked 2026-11-25
items.how_to_apply: Buy on Litacka (app/card) or as a paper voucher used with the CU student card; show proof of student status.
items.notes: Outside Prague (PID region) full-time students get 50% off only with a valid ISIC. 5- and 10-month tickets exist only electronically on Litacka (CU page).

items.description: The official list of income-tax credits for tax year 2025 contains the basic taxpayer credit (CZK 30,840), spouse, disability and ZTP/P credits, but no student credit; the former student tax credit is therefore not available for 2025.
items.amount: None (no student credit in the 2025 list); basic credit CZK 30,840/year (2025)
items.notes: The exact date of abolition was not confirmed on an official page (believed 2024, unverified). Students staying only to study are tax non-residents; non-residents get credits b-e only if EU/EEA tax residents with at least 90% of income from Czech sources (same page).

items.authority: Charles University (Rectorate), funded partly by MSMT
items.description: Bursary toward housing costs for full-time students in Czech-taught programmes. Basic version: within the standard length of study and not studying in the district of permanent residence (or in Prague if permanent residence is in Prague). An increased version is means-tested (household income up to 1.5x or 4x the living minimum).

eligibility.income_test: Basic: none; increased: household income up to 1.5x (1st category) or 4x (2nd category) the living minimum, with Labour Office certificate
eligibility.residence_requirement: Basic: permanent residence (trvale bydliste) not in the district where you study / not in Prague
other: Not studying in a foreign-language programme and not a fee-paying student
Studies not interrupted; at most two previous unsuccessful studies
Paid only to a bank account in Czechia

items.amount: Basic approx. CZK 750/month (illustration given for 2026/27, depends on number of applicants); increased approx. CZK 3,150 or 5,070/month
items.how_to_apply: Apply each academic year in the CU Student Information System (SIS).
items.deadline: 21 Oct - 21 Nov 2026 for the whole of 2026/27 (later windows 21 Jan and 21 Apr 2027 for remaining quarters); paid quarterly in arrears
items.stackable: Increased version can combine with the social bursary but not fully cumulatively (CU page).

interpretations.hypothesis: Foreign students in Czech-taught programmes can receive it on the same terms, since the conditions do not mention nationality.
The 'permanent residence' (trvale bydliste) test may be applied differently to foreigners without Czech permanent residence; the page does not explain how. Ask the CU Rectorate.

items.notes: Students in English-taught (fee-paying) programmes are excluded, which covers most international students.

items.name_local: Stipendia Univerzity Karlovy pro zahranicni studenty
items.name_it: Borse dell'Universita Carlo per studenti internazionali
items.description: CU lists: UJOP scholarships for selected foundation-programme students; MEYS schemes (developing countries, general scholarships, Visegrad Fund); the Vaclav Havel Bursary for students whose studies are hindered by repression in non-democratic regimes; faculty scholarships (Mathematics and Physics, Science STARS for PhD, Social Sciences 'FSV UK SCHOLARS'). After year one, most faculties offer merit scholarships and tuition fee waivers or reductions.

other: Conditions and amounts set by each faculty

items.how_to_apply: Contact the faculty's admission/study office; amounts are set by faculty regulations.

items.description: Full-time doctoral students receive a doctoral study income of at least 1.2 times the Czech minimum wage during the standard length of study (4 years), as a scholarship, a salary for dissertation-related work, or both.

other: Full-time PhD students within the standard length of study

items.amount: At least 1.2 x minimum wage (minimum wage CZK 22,400/month in 2026)
items.stackable: Often supplemented by project awards and teaching pay (CU page).

items.description: Programmes taught in Czech are free of charge for all students; a fee is charged only when the standard length of study is exceeded by more than one year. English/foreign-language programmes charge fees from EUR 40 to EUR 30,620 per year depending on the programme.

other: Must study in Czech (language requirement set by the programme)
